content:
Circumstances may not always be favourable to everyone at all times. Due to different reasons, you may not have been able to prepare well for your IELTS examination. You may feel worried about your strategies of preparation. At Casper, we provide the best IELTS coaching in Kochi. Though it is always advisable to prepare for the test thoroughly, preferably in a coaching centre, there are some last minute tips that prove to be useful. Even if you have only 10 more days left, try to be calm and do not get panicked. The useful strategy that we provide you is definitely going to work out, if you properly stick on to it. Let’s take a look at those points.

Day 1

Aim of the first day is to gain an in-depth idea about the IELTS exam. You should have a good idea about the pattern, number of questions, criteria, word limit and time. Begin with attending a mock test to find out what are your strengths and weaknesses and to know the test pattern.

Day 2

The major trick for the test is practice. On this day start practising and get your practice and research materials. Find reliable sources and work on different questions. On this day you will know if you need a coaching centre. Being the leading IELTS coaching centre Ernakulam, we polish our students to attend the exam with ease.

Day 3

Work out reading sections and try to develop the art of skimming and scanning. Read sample questions and instructions carefully and develop an understanding of paraphrasing and rewriting.

Day 4

Practice listening test, note down the questions and notice the keywords. Try to jot down the answers while you listen. Do not get panicked and train yourselves to be calm. Inorder to understand the accent, listen to BBC radio.

Day 5

Practice writing sections. Understanding the question is the key to answer the questions properly. Write the opinions and suggestions in 3rd person. Try to build an outline before you write and practice breaking the essay into paragraphs. We are the top IELTS coaching centre in Kochi that provides the best strategies.

Day 6

On this day, work on the speaking part, give attention to your pronunciation, sentence construction etc. Develop a good body language by grooming yourselves in front of the mirror. Inculcate a confident approach and work on vocabulary.

Day 7

This day should be dedicated to self reflection. Identify weaker sections and analyse the mistakes carefully. Work on weaker sections that need immediate attention and seek professional help if you require.

Day 8

Work on specific skills that you lack. Make sure to get reviewed by some experts in that particular area. It will enable you to realise more about yourselves.

Day 9

Analyse your skills again by opting for multiple tests. In this step you can find out the areas in which you have improved and it will help you to build confidence.

Day 10

On the final day, you should review your full journey. Just recapitulate the lessons and tactics you have learned so far. Our IELTS institution in Ernakulam is known for the quality teaching and great results in IELTS.
